hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Track accumulated unfinished backlog from previous shifts.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: In each shift, add incoming tasks to backlog and subtract processed capacity.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Clamp backlog to zero if capacity exceeds current work queue.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def unfinishedTasksAfterShifts(incoming: list[int], capacity: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    backlog = 0
    res = []
    for inc, cap in zip(incoming, capacity):
        backlog = max(0, backlog + inc - cap)
        res.append(backlog)
    return res
```
